review_text: The Temple Necklace exceeded all expectations for my sister's engagement. The antique finish looks stunning in photographs and feels remarkably regal.
Ordered the bridal necklace set to the UK. The craftsmanship is breathtaking, and the WhatsApp coordination made the entire ordering process seamless.
The pearl jhumkas are lightweight yet majestic. Perfect balance of traditional grandeur and all-day comfort for festive celebrations.
